request_summary: [cold-start] I prefer terse responses without trailing summaries — just show me the diff.

input.content:
---
name: feedback-response-style
description: User wants terse responses with no trailing summaries — show diffs directly without commentary
metadata:
  type: feedback
---

Keep responses terse. No trailing summaries or recaps. When showing changes, present the diff directly without extra commentary.

**Why:** User finds summaries and wrap-ups unnecessary noise.
**How to apply:** After making edits, stop. Don't add "Here's what I changed:" or "In summary…" closers.
- [Response style](feedback_response_style.md) — Terse responses, no summaries, show diffs directly
